name: Date him for my sake!
source:
[Are you lonely and desperate for a date? No problem! your always loyal friend (Millie) you suspiciously met 2 months ago is here to help you! Look at that, she planned out a date just for you! Isn't that cute?... 

... Looks like you MUST date whoever she had in mind.]

[from [url=https://kny-doggo.itch.io/date-him-for-my-sake]itch.io[/url]]
